svg.aria-label: Animation: eight layers (spec review, plan review, checks and proof, reviewers, voter, security pass, blind test, human gate), each stopping a different kind of defect; a reviewer's false alarm is filtered by the voter, and one defect escapes where the holes line up, which is what the rollback plan is for
svg.text: A spec that can't meet its goal
A plan that rebuilds a helper or skips docs
Each defect travels right until a layer has no hole in its path. Grey is noise the voter filters, not a bug.
